output.summary: The 98% figure rests on a TMS definition that lets dispatchers replace the promised date. Revisions rose 5x from March, exactly when the bonus took effect (Northgate and Riverside in March, Pell Junction in July). Reason codes shifted from Customer Request to Operational - Capacity, late revisions rose, and customer notification fell. Brightwell's receiving logs show 81% against the original date, down from 87%, while the scorecard claimed 98.4%. So reported on-time is likely masking deterioration, and the advertising claim and a higher bonus would be harmful. The driver shortage link is only correlational and unadjusted. RouteWise and the portal complaints have no evidence either way. Best next steps are recomputing on-time against the original date and re-basing the incentive.
